name: Eight-day run below/above SMA5 fade (Connors-style run exhaustion)
author: Pine community script
license: GPL-3.0 (collection repository LICENSE; individual source copyright/terms may differ)
instruments_timeframes: Source does not impose a universal market/timeframe unless stated in the rules; use chart-selected symbol and timeframe.
entry_long: Script condition: Buy = (bars since last close below SMA(5) were >= 8 on the previous bar) AND close <= SMA(5). Description says: enter long after a run of 8 or more closes on one side of SMA(5) at the first cross back.
entry_short: After 8+ closes above SMA(5), short on first close at/below SMA(5) per script (Sell = TriggerSell[1] and TrendUp).
exit: Exit long when close > SMA(5); short exit when close < SMA(5).
position_sizing: Not specified by the source beyond its strategy() defaults; no sizing inferred.
filters: None beyond those listed in the entry rules.
implementation_notes: Entry condition in code reads Buy = TriggerBuy[1] and TrendDown which is confusing relative to the description ("first close above the 5 SMA"); verify the logic by backtest before relying on it.
